A '''Tiger's Eye crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The Tiger's Rye crystal was a dark brown in color with a central yellow eye, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. The [[Tasari]] cult leader [[Garuk]] wore a bracelet on his left arm inset with a Tiger's Eye crystal.<ref name="J15" />
